messages:
jordan-cs: Hey team — Mira Telecom (mid-market) submitted a formal request this morning for a custom NER model to extract PII + billing codes from customer support call transcripts. They want on-prem or VPC option, and they flagged PHI in a few accounts. Renewal in ~90 days so this is high impact for retention.

mira-pm: thanks Jordan. main ask: near-real-time extraction (sub-2s per call segment), <5% false positive rate on billing codes, and strict PHI handling. They also want a short eval plan and an estimate for Dedicated capacity.

intake-bot: New intake form received: customer_id=MT-8742, use_case=call-transcript-ner, priority=high, compliance=HIPAA, requested_deploy=private.

jordan-cs: Can we get an initial feasibility + risk note for the AM? Also need recommended eval dataset size and rough time-to-deliver for proof-of-concept.

nina-eng: quick read — model's doable but PHI requirement means Private deployment + KMS/HSM. We'll need sample transcripts with redaction hints to calibrate prefix caching. For latency: Dedicated with batch size 1 and KV-optimized runtime should hit ~1.5s p95 on A10x-like fleet.

liam-ml: For quality targets: recommend a labeled eval set of 2k annotated segments for initial baseline (stratified by call length and region). We'll run metrics: precision/recall for PII labels, billing-code exact match, and a PHI-leakage check (token overlap with protected lists). Can produce initial eval within 2-3 weeks once we have data.

ruth-safety: PHI handling notes: must enforce data-in-flight encryption, customer-managed keys, and audit logs for access. We'll require a safety evaluation that includes adversarial prompts to check hallucinated PHI attribution and a redaction fallback pipeline. Also need PHI-specific annotations in eval to measure false negative rate.

sam-success: I'll coordinate with Mira for data access and an NDA addendum for sample transcripts. Suggest we schedule a 30-min enablement call to walk through onboarding, and share a checklist for ingestion, key rotation, and evaluation expectations.

jordan-cs: Agree. Also flagging renewal risk — Mira's been throttling usage after last quarter's latency spikes. If we can land a short POC with clear latency/quality wins within 6 weeks, it materially increases renewal odds.

nina-eng: Next steps from infra: provide a Dedicated capacity quote (incl. burst) and a private deployment checklist. I'll draft a config example for autoscale policies and KV cache settings.

liam-ml: I'll draft the eval rubric and a small script to compute precision/recall, billing-code exact match, and PHI-leakage heuristics. Will attach expected labels schema.

ruth-safety: I'll own the safety eval. Need to know if they plan to route third-party vendor transcriptions through Redwood or pre-store transcripts in their VPC. That impacts our leakage model.

mira-pm: we'll likely pre-store transcripts in our S3 behind VPC. Also willing to do redaction before transfer if recommended.

sam-success: Scheduling: Mira ok for a call Wed 0900 PT? I'll send calendar invite and a short pre-call checklist: sample subset (50 anonymized segments), compliance contacts, expected SLA needs, and desired KPIs.

jordan-cs: Perfect. For the POC timeline proposal: Week 0: intake + NDA + sample transfer. Weeks 1-2: baseline model + eval. Weeks 3-4: fine-tune/tuning + latency tuning on Dedicated. Week 6: POC demo + handoff. If all aligned I can push this as a prioritized onboarding.

nina-eng: thumbs up. I'll also include a note on recommended quantization profile for cost control if they want lower unit costs.

liam-ml: One more ask: does Mira need human-in-the-loop correction UI? That affects labeling cadence and long-term model improvement.

mira-pm: yes, please include an optional HIL plan and estimated ops cost.

ruth-safety: final: add an automated rollback policy in case PHI regression is detected during rollout. We'll define thresholds in the eval rubric.

sam-success: I'll capture all action items and send a follow-up thread after the call. Thanks y'all :rocket:
